relationships.subject: CFA inflammation
relationships.evidence_quote: Following peripheral inflammation, TRPC3 and TRPC6 expression exhibited significant upregulation in IB4‐labeled and CGRP‐expressing DRG neurons

relationships.subject: TRPC3/6
relationships.evidence_quote: Overall, these data suggest that TRPC3/6 at DRG plays an important role in the regulation of nociceptor excitability and hyperexcitability after peripheral inflammation.

relationships.subject: TRPC3/6
relationships.evidence_quote: These results suggest that presynaptic TRPC3/6 facilitates activity‐dependent BDNF secretion from spinal nociceptor terminals.

relationships.subject: TRPC3/6
relationships.evidence_quote: These results suggest that TRPC3/6 contributes to spinal synaptic potentiation after peripheral inflammation.

relationships.subject: bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPC3/6 in primary sensory neurons get recruited via released bradykinin acting on B1/B2 receptors

relationships.subject: TRPC3/6
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicate that TRPC3 and TRPC6 collectively contribute to mechanical pain hypersensitivity associated with tissue inflammation.

key_findings: TRPC3/6 are upregulated in DRG and dorsal horn (mouse and human) and drive nociceptor hyperexcitability, spinal LTP and mechanical hypersensitivity.
Bradykinin via B1/B2 receptors recruits TRPC3/6, facilitating BDNF secretion from nociceptor terminals.
